title: OIDC Session Management
subtitle: An app polls the IdP for “is the session still valid?” using postMessage between iframes — the poll is not HTTP, so it’s invisible in the Network tab; only the iframe load and silent re-auth are.

steps.label: Load RP + OP check_session iframes
steps.lede: At login the IdP returned a session_state (hash.salt) and published a check_session_iframe. The RP loads a hidden RP iframe alongside the OP’s check_session iframe to watch for session changes.
steps.devtools: Open DevTools (F12) → Network, enable Preserve log. Crucial quirk: the polling itself is not on the network — only the iframe load and the prompt=none re-auth are real HTTP requests.

steps.label: OP check_session_iframe loads
steps.lede: The OP’s check_session iframe loads as a hidden frame. It reads the OP browser-state cookie that the poll will hash against.
steps.devtools: Filter on check_session. It loads as a hidden frame (Sec-Fetch-Dest: iframe). This is the last real network request you’ll see until something changes.

steps.label: The poll loop (postMessage — NOT HTTP)
steps.lede: Every few seconds the RP iframe postMessages "client_id session_state" to the OP iframe, which recomputes the hash from the browser-state cookie and replies "unchanged", "changed", or "error". None of this is a network request.
steps.codeTitle: window.postMessage exchange (watch it in the Console)
steps.devtools: Not in the Network tab. This is window.postMessage — window messaging inside the browser. Watch it in the Console, or set a window.addEventListener("message", …) breakpoint in Sources.

steps.label: On “changed”: silent re-auth (prompt=none)
steps.lede: A "changed" reply triggers a silent re-authentication in a hidden iframe. prompt=none means no UI: it succeeds with a code if the user is still logged in at the OP, or errors with login_required if not.
steps.devtools: Filter on authorize. Confirm prompt=none plus state and nonce. Read the response Location: success → silent-cb?code=…; failure → silent-cb?error=login_required (user logged out at the OP → the RP ends its local session).

steps.label: Exchange code for fresh tokens
steps.lede: On success the RP redeems the code at /token and receives a fresh id_token plus a new session_state to resume polling with.

jwt.title: Decoded id_token (silent re-auth)
payload: Issuer — validate even on silent re-auth
ORIGINAL login time — unchanged; the OP session persisted
Must match the nonce sent on the prompt=none request
Same session id — confirms it’s the same OP session

steps.devtools: Filter on token. In the Response JSON, note the new session_state the RP stores to resume polling, and decode the id_token. A "changed" postMessage is only a trigger — full ID-token validation (signature, iss, aud, nonce) still applies. Note auth_time did not advance: no fresh credential prompt occurred.

steps.label: Resume polling (or degrade)
steps.lede: The RP updates its stored session_state and resumes the postMessage loop. If the OP iframe persistently replies "error", detection is unreliable and the RP must fall back.
steps.devtools: A persistent "error" reply in the Console means the OP iframe can’t read the browser-state cookie (third-party cookie blocking / storage partitioning). Treat it as “session state unknown” and fall back to front-channel or back-channel logout.
